profile_text.body:
Berkshire Grey describes itself as a provider of AI-powered robotic automation for warehouse, ecommerce, retail, and 3PL logistics operations. In its own words, it offers physical AI warehouse automation intended to accelerate fulfillment, reduce operating costs, and scale with a customer's business. The company is a for-profit founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bedford, Massachusetts.

The site names one specific product, Stride, described as a shuttle sorting system that handles a wide range of item types. It uses autonomous shuttles and intelligent routing to automate sorting, which the company presents as delivering reliable, scalable throughput.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 187. No court cases, no MCP servers, and no additional products are listed for it.
